optional_facts.text: Tier 1 can ask the Device Service desk by a note on the claim record.

known_conflicts.topic: How long a repair quote stays open

acceptable_inference: Advising the agent to quote the shorter period so the customer is not caught out.
oracle.expected_behavior_note: Two current documents disagree and neither says it replaces the other on this point. The Repair and Replacement Service Terms (version 2.2, 1 September 2026) say the quote stays open for 10 calendar days from the day it is sent, after which the unit is sent back unrepaired at no charge. The Quality Scorecard Guide (version 1.4, 28 September 2026) lists, among the things the customer must hear, that the quote stays open for 15 calendar days. Nothing loaded settles it. The right private advice names both figures, suggests giving the customer the shorter one as the safe date or checking with the Device Service desk through the claim record, and does not present either as certain.

required_facts.text: The repair terms say the quote stays open for 10 calendar days from the day it is sent.
The quality guide says the customer is told the quote stays open for 15 calendar days.

forbidden_claims.text: Tells the agent to promise the customer 15 days with no mention that the repair terms say 10.
Gives a period that belongs to something else in the repair terms.
Invents a rule for which of the two documents wins.

oracle.expected_role: Tier 1 support agent asking privately mid-call; the answer advises the agent and may give words to say

items.question: My sister's over in Pellham Sound and she wants hers put up by your people as well. When do you start doing the fitting over there?

optional_facts.text: Pellham Sound is a planned area; no bookings are taken.
An opening date is given only when the sheet shows one marked as announced.

acceptable_inference: Saying the area is on the list of places being prepared.
Suggesting she ask again later.
oracle.expected_behavior_note: Nothing loaded gives an opening date for Pellham Sound. The Fit Service Areas sheet lists it as Planned with the note that the partner contract is signed and no bookings are to be taken; its live date, appointment days and earliest slot are empty. The Fit guide says that for a planned area the agent says Fit is not available there yet and gives an opening date only when the sheet shows one marked as announced. A neighbouring row makes an invention tempting: Fennick Bay, another planned area, has a target of January 2027, which is not announced and is not Pellham Sound's. The right reply says Fit is not available in Pellham Sound yet and that there is no date to give, without offering a booking and without saying it will never come.

forbidden_claims.text: Gives an opening date or month for Pellham Sound, including Fennick Bay's target.
Gives another area's live date, or another month, as the start.
Offers to book a visit in Pellham Sound, or to put her on a list that nothing loaded mentions.
Says Fit will not be offered in Pellham Sound.

oracle.expected_role: Tier 1 support agent speaking to the customer on the call, first person

items.question: customer says she lives a short drive from the repair centre and would rather bring her trek cam in herself than post it. what's the address and what are the opening hours

optional_facts.text: Units travel under the label to the service centre in Marrow Creek.
Tier 1 reaches the Device Service desk by a note on the claim record; customers are not put through.

acceptable_inference: Saying the service centre is in Marrow Creek.
Saying the terms provide for sending the unit under the label and for nothing else.
oracle.expected_behavior_note: Nothing loaded gives a street address or opening hours for the service centre, and nothing says a unit can be handed in there. The repair terms say only that units travel under the Return Authorisation label to the service centre in Marrow Creek, that a parcel without a Return Authorisation number on its label goes back to the sender, and that customers are not put through to the Device Service desk. Tempting inventions: the warehouse in Tolliver Falls from the shipping policy, which is a different place, and the working hours of other desks (the Fit Programme desk, Tier 2). The right private advice says there is no address or opening time to give, that the documented route is the label e-mailed with the Return Authorisation, and that the agent can put the request to the Device Service desk in a note on the claim record, which is answered by the end of the next business day.

forbidden_claims.text: Sends the customer to the warehouse in Tolliver Falls.
Gives opening hours, including another desk's hours.
Gives a street address for the service centre.
Tells the agent the customer can simply turn up with the camera.

oracle.expected_role: Tier 1 support agent asking privately mid-call; the answer advises the agent and may give words to say

items.question: caller's in greyling ford and wants a fit visit as soon as we can manage. how many days out is the first slot the calendar will give her if I book it right now

optional_facts.text: Greyling Ford works Tuesday to Saturday, has a $25 travel fee and no high-mount crew.
The earliest-slot figure counts calendar days from the day of booking.

acceptable_inference: Adding that visits there run Tuesday to Saturday.
Mentioning the $25 travel fee.
oracle.expected_behavior_note: The Fit Service Areas sheet gives an earliest slot for every live area, and the rows look alike. Greyling Ford (FA-14): 9, meaning the first day the calendar can offer is 9 calendar days after the day of booking. The rows around it give other figures: Elmhollow 4, Halvergate 2; Osterbrook, with the same appointment days, 6; Yarrowby 10. Greyling Ford works Tuesday to Saturday, so the first slot is the first of those days from day 9 on. The agent gives the 9 days as what the calendar will show, not as a promise of a particular date.

required_facts.text: Greyling Ford's earliest slot is 9 calendar days after the day of booking.

forbidden_claims.text: Gives Elmhollow's figure.
Gives Halvergate's figure.
Gives Osterbrook's figure.
Gives Yarrowby's figure.
Promises the customer a particular date or an earlier slot.
